events.text: The peak was discovered and originally named Mount Kaufmann.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The peak was discovered in 1871 and originally named Mount Kaufmann

events.text: The mountain was renamed Lenin Peak.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1928 , the mountain was renamed Lenin Peak

events.text: In Tajikistan, the peak was renamed again.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In Tajikistan , the peak was renamed again in July 2006
